title: Group Anagrams
statement: Group the strings so that words made of the same letters land in the same group. Return the groups in any order, and the words within a group in any order.
hints: Two words are anagrams exactly when some canonical form of them is equal.
Sorting a word characters gives such a canonical form. So does a 26-slot letter count.
Use that canonical form as a Dictionary key mapping to the list of words that produced it.
complexity: O(n * k log k) time, where k is word length
